CSB CSRTI Project Assistant Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CSB CSRTI Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the CSB Central Sericultural Research and Training Institute (CSB CSRTI) for filling up project-based positions in Mysore, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Project Assistant under advertisement number PIP03017MIC, offering candidates an opportunity to work in research fields related to sericulture.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the Project Assistant post. Interested eligible candidates can directly participate in the scheduled walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc in Agriculture, Life Science, or Chemical Science. Additional higher qualifications like M.Sc may fetch a higher consolidated monthly salary.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant position is 30 years, with appropriate age relaxations applicable for SC, ST, OBC, women, and physically challenged candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary structure?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary ranges from Rs. 15,000/- to Rs. 20,000/- per month depending on the candidate's qualification, such as B.Sc, PGD in Sericulture, or M.Sc degrees.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the CSB CSRTI Project Assistant recruitment is scheduled to take place on 8 October 2026 at the designated institute venue.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly walk-in. Candidates do not need to send online applications beforehand; they must directly appear at the venue with all required documents.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Applicants must bring their updated bio-data, two passport-size photographs, original certificates from SSLC to degree levels, experience certificates, and valid ID and caste proofs.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be posted at the CSB Central Sericultural Research and Training Institute located in Mysore, Karnataka, with the pincode 570008.
